hero.title: NiceChunk 合约、真实游戏配置与 PDA 透明度。
hero.subtitle: 这个页面现在会区分游戏客户端真实使用的运行配置，以及代码里已经存在但仍门禁的合约。玩家可以在同一页检查源码、PDA 结构和公开 devnet 账户。
hero.networkNote: 当前游戏运行配置通过 mainnet.json 指向 Solana devnet。这里不声称主网最终状态，也不声称文明治理已经真实开放。

directory.title: 当前 NiceChunk 程序与运行状态。
directory.body: 下表列出仓库里的合约、Program ID，以及它们当前是否已进入游戏运行配置或仍处于门禁。

flow.title: 当前游戏流程如何触达链上程序

steps.title: 读取创世配置
steps.body: 客户端从 Core 程序推导 GlobalConfig，并读取世界种子、Chunk 大小、建造高度、NCK mint 和公开配置哈希。
steps.writes: No user write; derives GlobalConfig PDA
steps.audit: GlobalConfig magic, world seed, hash fields, and runtime program IDs

steps.title: 创建玩家档案
steps.body: Player 程序记录钱包拥有的玩家档案、默认属性、坐标、装备槽和背包样式。
steps.audit: Owner wallet, profile name, position, equipped backpack, and update slot

steps.title: 开启挖矿会话
steps.body: 玩家可以创建一个短期 session authority，让连续挖矿不需要每破坏一个方块都弹出钱包确认。
steps.writes: PlayerSession PDA with authority, expiry, and action budget
steps.audit: Allowed action bitmask, maxActions, usedActions, expiresAt

steps.title: 记录已破坏方块
steps.body: Chunk 程序校验单点生成方块，然后把 3 字节压缩记录写入 chunk-broken PDA。
steps.writes: ChunkBrokenState record under the Chunk program
steps.audit: Packed broken-block records, minY, count/capacity, and block proof assumptions

steps.title: 追加资源记录
steps.body: Backpack 程序已经预留好在 session 校验后追加挖掘资源记录，是挖矿到背包流程的库存侧桥接。
steps.audit: Foundation footprint, revision state, shard bitmap, NCM3 hash, and Guardian blueprint hash

steps.title: 把资源熔炼成物品
steps.body: Smelting 程序读取 RecipeTable PDA，验证选中的背包输入和燃料槽，通过 Backpack 程序移除这些槽位，再由 smelting-authority PDA 把材料或物品产物追加回同一个背包。
steps.writes: Backpack slot append or mutation through authorized program signer
steps.audit: Backpack owner, itemCount, slot payload, durability, material/item identity

steps.title: 挂单资源或资产
steps.body: Marketplace 会验证背包资源槽或 Market Asset PDA，然后在可购买前把物品锁定到 Listing PDA 中。
steps.writes: RecipeTable read plus Backpack remove/append through smelting authority
steps.audit: Recipe IDs, heat tiers, input/output volumes, disabled recipes, output slot evidence

steps.title: 结算市场订单
steps.body: 买家用 NCK 或 SOL 支付，程序把 1% 市场手续费转到 treasury，并通过市场 authority 把被托管的背包 slot 交付给买家。
steps.audit: Seller, buyer, currency, price, escrow state, and original slot snapshot

steps.title: Publish Player Buildings
steps.body: The building program validates player sessions, indexes foundation chunks, stages NCM3 payload shards, finalizes a hashed manifest, and can publish Guardian blueprint summaries.
steps.writes: Listing settlement and buyer Backpack delivery
steps.audit: Treasury fee routing, payment mint/native flag, settled slot, and final listing state

programs.name: NiceChunk Genesis Core
programs.role: 不可变世界配置与 NCK mint 校验。
programs.summary: Core 程序只负责一次性初始化 GlobalConfig PDA。它写入编译期创世参数，包括世界种子、世界 ID、配置哈希、NCK mint、NCK decimals、创世供应量、费用、Chunk 限制和 Guardian 参数。它不负责铸造物品、不管理背包、不提供管理员更新配置，也不承载复杂玩法逻辑。
instructions: 校验 SPL Token mint 布局、decimals、初始化状态、创世供应量、mint authority 已关闭、freeze authority 已关闭。
即使 PDA 被提前转入 dust lamports，也可以安全 create 或 allocate GlobalConfig PDA。
storage: 世界 ID 和 32 字节世界种子。
地形、资源规则和客户端世界配置哈希。
NCK mint、decimals、创世供应量和开发钱包。
Chunk 大小、section 高度、建造范围、最大地形高度、海平面、冷却和 Guardian 设置。
notes: 这是当前开发网版本的不可变创世配置层。
未来的合成、库存、Chunk 状态、世界知识和声望系统应放在独立程序或 PDA 规格稳定后的后续模块。
开发网和测试网必须使用各自独立的 NCK mint，不应该把主网 mint 直接用于开发集群。

pdaAccounts.name: GlobalConfig
pdaAccounts.purpose: 当前世界不可变的创世配置。

programs.name: NiceChunk Player
programs.role: 钱包拥有的玩家档案、坐标、装备槽、背包样式和挖矿会话授权。
programs.summary: Player 程序创建钱包绑定的玩家档案，并支持短期 session authority。session 让游戏可以提交重复的允许操作，例如破坏方块，而不需要每挖一个方块都打开钱包确认。
storage: Owner 钱包、GlobalConfig 地址、world ID、已绑定背包公钥、bump 和时间戳。
基础属性：生命、能量、体力、挖掘力、建造力和防御。
当前坐标、9 个装备槽和已绑定背包公钥。
Session authority、允许动作 bitmask、过期时间、最大动作次数和已用次数。
notes: 玩家档案是公开状态。它保存已绑定背包公钥，私密背包内容应在玩家打开背包流程时单独加载。
当前 session 模型用于减少连续挖矿时的钱包弹窗。
Session 受过期时间、允许动作和最大动作次数限制。

pdaAccounts.name: PlayerProfile
pdaAccounts.purpose: 钱包拥有的公开玩家状态，以及已装备背包指针。
fields: 基础生命、能量、体力和能力字段

pdaAccounts.name: PlayerSession
pdaAccounts.purpose: 短期玩法授权，让连续允许行为不必每次弹钱包。

programs.name: NiceChunk Chunk
programs.role: 校验单点生成方块，并按 Chunk 记录极简已破坏方块状态。
programs.accountSize: ChunkState: 8,280 bytes; ChunkBrokenState: 16-byte header + 3 bytes per record
programs.summary: Chunk 程序支持旧版 Chunk delta 账户，也支持当前优化后的挖矿路径。挖矿时，玩家提交一个世界方块坐标。程序推导所在 Chunk，校验生成方块，拒绝空气、水、基岩或已经被挖过的位置，然后追加一条压缩的已破坏方块记录。
storage: 旧版 ChunkState 最多记录 128 条 64 字节 block delta。
ChunkBrokenState 存 16 字节 header 和每条 3 字节的已挖记录。
记录会打包 local x、local z 和 y offset。初始容量 64，每次扩容 64，最大 2,048 条。
生成方块校验使用 GlobalConfig 中的世界种子、Chunk 大小、建造高度、最大地形高度和海平面。
notes: 这是当前浏览器客户端使用的挖矿写入路径。
代码里保留了 MagicBlock delegation hook，但当前玩法路径不依赖 MagicBlock。
背包资源结算刻意拆成独立程序，方便挖矿状态和库存状态分别演进。

pdaAccounts.name: ChunkBrokenState
pdaAccounts.purpose: 记录玩家破坏过的生成方块，不存完整地形。
fields: 3 字节 packed 本地方块记录
通过扩容存稀疏变化，而不是存整块地形

pdaAccounts.name: ResourceDropTable
pdaAccounts.purpose: 奖励挖矿的有界额外掉落规则。
fields: salt plus min/max drop volume in mm³

programs.name: NiceChunk Building
programs.kind: Build sites, NCM3 building manifests, and Guardian blueprint publishing
programs.role: Owns BuildSite v2 accounts, chunk indexing, building manifests, upload shards, resize flow, and Guardian blueprint publishing authority.
programs.accountSize: BuildSite: 160 bytes; legacy BuildSite: 136 bytes; BuildingManifest: 160 bytes; BuildingShard: 64 + payload bytes
programs.summary: The Building program is the active devnet surface for player-owned foundations and NCM3 building payloads. It validates player sessions, creates and resizes BuildSite accounts, registers occupied chunks through the chunk authority PDA, stages building uploads in shards, finalizes manifests after hash and fit checks, supports legacy BuildSite migration, and publishes Guardian blueprint updates through a program-derived authority.
storage: BuildSite stores owner, global config, foundation ID, footprint, surface Y, active and pending revisions, indexed chunk counters, staged resize dimensions, and update slots.
BuildingManifest stores owner, global config, foundation ID, revision, payload length, expected NCM3 hash, dimensions, rotation, offsets, shard count, uploaded bitmap, and status.
BuildingShard stores one bounded payload segment for an NCM3 building upload, with uploaded length and payload bytes after the 64-byte header.
notes: Build actions require a valid PlayerSession and matching PlayerProfile before state changes are accepted.
A BuildingManifest only becomes active after all shards are written, the payload hash matches, and the NCM3 dimensions fit the BuildSite footprint and world height limits.
Guardian blueprint publication is restricted to the treasury or configured blueprint publisher wallet and calls the Guardian program through the Building program PDA.
The 136-byte legacy BuildSite layout is still decoded so deployed foundations can be migrated safely.

pdaAccounts.name: BuildSite
pdaAccounts.purpose: Player-owned foundation footprint and revision state for a build site.

pdaAccounts.name: BuildingManifest
pdaAccounts.purpose: Upload and activation manifest for one NCM3 building revision.

pdaAccounts.name: BuildingShard
pdaAccounts.size: 64-byte header plus payload, up to 8,256 bytes
pdaAccounts.purpose: Bounded shard payload used to upload an NCM3 building before finalization.

pdaAccounts.name: GuardianBlueprintAuthority
pdaAccounts.purpose: Program signer for publishing verified building blueprint summaries into Guardian regions.
fields: Calls Guardian update_blueprint with the expected region and global config

programs.name: NiceChunk Guardian Registry
programs.role: 登记 Guardian 区域、服务端点、NCK 国库支付、存活证明、结算和端点更新。
programs.summary: Guardian 程序记录区域实时基础设施的公开服务端点。Guardian 注册区域，向国库 token account 支付 NCK 注册金额，并周期性提交证明。登记表是非托管的，不替玩家签名或处理链上交易。
storage: Registry 存 GlobalConfig、NCK mint、treasury token account、active count 和 genesis flag。
Region 存状态、区域坐标、owner/operator 钱包、endpoint host、port、TLS flag、质押金额、slash 总额、证明次数和时间戳。
区域大小是 100 x 100 个 Chunk。注册需要支付 100,000 NCK 到国库，NCK 为 6 decimals。
证明间隔是 3,600 秒。结算可以对未按时证明的节点每次扣 10%，直到移除。
notes: 当前网页 Guardian 页面从开发网读取 registry 和 region PDA 数据。
端点更新仅允许当前 Guardian 运营钱包执行。国库治理钱包可轮换运营钱包；治理钱包或受限的蓝图发布钱包可更新蓝图元数据。
注册支付进入国库 token account；该登记表不提供用户主动 unstake 或 withdraw。

pdaAccounts.name: GuardianRegistry
pdaAccounts.purpose: 全局 Guardian 注册表和国库指针。

pdaAccounts.name: GuardianRegion
pdaAccounts.purpose: 已注册实时区域端点和质押状态。
fields: 区域坐标和 Chunk 边界

programs.name: NiceChunk Backpack
programs.kind: Inventory slot layer for blocks, resources, and items
programs.role: Creates player backpacks, stores block-resource and item slots, removes selected slots, and accepts marketplace or smelting-authorized delivery.
programs.summary: The backpack program is the inventory storage layer for mined block resources, smelted materials, forged items, and marketplace escrow. Version 3 stores fixed 80-byte slots that represent block resources, material items, and forged items with durability, grade, item level, quality, and metadata. Mining appends block-resource slots through validated player sessions, marketplace flows can remove and restore resources, and smelting can append item slots only through the smelting authority PDA.
instructions: requires a PlayerProfile with no equipped backpack
storage: Backpack header stores backpack ID, owner, capacity, item count, state, placement fields, timestamps, and flags.
Default capacity is 50 slots. Max capacity is 99 slots.
Each v3 BackpackSlotRecord is 80 bytes: kind, category, flags, quantity, resource coordinate, item code, item ID, item PDA, volume, durability, grade, item level, quality, and metadata.
Slot kind 1 stores block resources. Slot kind 2 stores item/material records such as smelted outputs or forged outputs.
The decoder only accepts the current v3 account layout.
notes: Backpack contents are separate from public player profile display; the player profile stores only the equipped backpack public key.
The marketplace program can escrow or deliver backpack resources through the market-authority PDA.
The smelting program can append material or item outputs through the smelting-authority PDA; users cannot mint arbitrary item slots directly.
Direct player appends remain restricted to validated mining sessions for block resources.

pdaAccounts.name: Backpack
pdaAccounts.purpose: 钱包拥有的库存 PDA，保存方块资源和物品引用。
fields: 最多 99 个 slot，记录方块资源或物品引用

programs.name: NiceChunk Smelting
programs.kind: Recipe table and backpack item creation layer
programs.role: Stores smelting recipe tables, consumes selected backpack resources and fuels, and appends material or item outputs back into the backpack.
programs.summary: The smelting program separates recipe authority from backpack storage. A recipe table PDA stores up to 12 recipes, each with up to 8 input slots and 4 output slots. Executing a recipe validates selected backpack inputs and fuel, removes those slots through the backpack program, then appends material or item outputs through the smelting authority PDA.
instructions: execute_smelting supports input indexes, fuel indexes, and a batch multiplier.
storage: RecipeTable stores table ID, authority, recipe count, timestamps, and fixed-size recipe records.
Each RecipeRecord stores recipe ID, enabled flag, minimum heat tier, input count, output count, up to 8 input BackpackSlot records, up to 4 output BackpackSlot records, and updated slot.
BackpackSlot records support block resources and item/material outputs.
Recipe table authority can upsert recipes or transfer authority.
notes: The recipe table is intentionally independent so civilization or governance systems can add and update recipes later.
Execution validates backpack ownership, recipe matching, input slots, fuel slots, and batch multiplier before consuming inventory.
Outputs are appended through the backpack program using the smelting authority PDA; users cannot mint arbitrary smelting outputs directly.

pdaAccounts.name: RecipeTable
pdaAccounts.purpose: 由 authority 管理、供熔炼程序读取的配方表。
fields: 最多 12 条 recipe 记录
每条配方保存热力等级、输入槽、输出槽和 updatedSlot

pdaAccounts.name: SmeltingAuthority
pdaAccounts.purpose: 配方验证后，用作把产物追加回背包的程序签名 PDA。
fields: 不保存玩家可变资产状态

programs.name: NiceChunk Marketplace
programs.kind: 背包 slot 市场结算层
programs.role: 从卖家 Backpack PDA 创建挂单，托管完整 80 字节 slot，结算 NCK 或 SOL 付款，并在取消或购买时恢复/交付库存。
programs.summary: 市场程序是当前 devnet 的背包库存交易面。卖家只能从自己的 Backpack PDA 选择一个已有 slot 上架；合约会读取该 slot、移除它，并把完整 80 字节 slot 快照写入 Listing PDA。取消会把 slot 还给卖家，购买会把 slot 交付给买家；用户 payload 不再提供分类、数量、耐久、品级、等级或 item hash。
instructions: 创建挂单只接受 listingId、currency、sourceIndex 和 price；物品参数从 Backpack PDA 读取。
取消和购买通过 market-authority PDA 把 Listing 内保存的 80 字节 slot 写回目标 Backpack。
支付支持 NCK 和 SOL，并收取 1% 市场手续费。
storage: Listing 保存卖家钱包、listing ID、币种、来源背包索引、价格、完整来源 slot 快照、时间戳、买家和最终结算字段。
来源 slot 在 create_listing 时从 Backpack v3 slot 数据复制；category、quantity、itemCode、durability、grade、itemLevel 和 quality 都不接受用户 payload。
Listing 状态为 active、canceled 或 sold。
notes: 只有挂单卖家可以取消活跃挂单。
买家不能购买自己的挂单。
只有 marketplace PDA 可以通过背包程序恢复或交付托管 slot。
Treasury 费用为所选币种挂单价格的 1%。

pdaAccounts.name: MarketplaceListing
pdaAccounts.purpose: 卖家拥有的背包 slot 托管和市场结算状态。
fields: 完整 80 字节 sourceSlot 快照

pdaAccounts.name: MarketplaceAuthority
pdaAccounts.purpose: 托管恢复、交付和结算边界的程序签名者。
fields: Does not custody player wallets outside explicit instructions

programs.name: NiceChunk Civilization 文明合约
programs.status: 代码已具备 / 仍门禁
programs.role: 发布规则书、签名、计票、执行回执、文明值快照和玩家文明值账户。
programs.magic: NCKCVR01 / NCKCVS01 / NCKCVT01 / NCKCVE01 / NCKCVP01 / NCKCVC01
programs.accountSize: RuleBook: 320; Signature: 136; Tally: 128; Receipt: 128; PowerSnapshot: 128; CitizenPower: 144 bytes
programs.summary: 文明合约已经存在于仓库和 SDK 中，但还没有进入当前 mainnet.json 游戏运行配置。它是门禁中的规则层，用于发布文明规则提案、用已结算贡献权力签署、计票、记录执行，并通过 PDA 账户让文明值可审计。
storage: RuleBook 保存哈希、目标程序/PDA、阈值、风险等级、总权力、所需权力和计票计数。
RuleSignature 保存签署方选择和已结算快照权力。
PowerSnapshot 保存 authority 签名的总活跃权力、窗口 epoch、哈希和过期时间。
CitizenPower 保存绑定到一个快照和有效期窗口的玩家文明值。
notes: 程序部署和 devnet e2e 证明完成前，玩家链上提交故意保持门禁。
文明值不能自报；权力快照和玩家文明值结算需要配置的 authority 签名。
现在公开展示此合约，是为了让玩家在真实治理启用前检查 PDA 结构。

pdaAccounts.name: RuleBook
pdaAccounts.purpose: 绑定目标程序和目标 PDA 的文明规则提案。

pdaAccounts.name: RuleSignature
pdaAccounts.purpose: 规则书中一个签署者的选择和已结算贡献权力。

pdaAccounts.name: RuleTally
pdaAccounts.purpose: 规则书最终计票记录。

pdaAccounts.name: ExecutionReceipt
pdaAccounts.purpose: 记录已通过规则被执行或确认的回执。

pdaAccounts.name: PowerSnapshot
pdaAccounts.purpose: authority 签名的文明值窗口快照。

pdaAccounts.name: CitizenPower
pdaAccounts.purpose: 某个快照窗口内一个玩家的贡献权力。

global-config.body: 当前开发网世界的不可变创世配置。
global-config.visible: NCK mint、世界 ID、世界种子哈希材料、配置哈希、Chunk 限制和守护者参数。
global-config.trust: 证明世界种子、资源配置或核心限制不是由私有服务器偷偷改变。

player-profile.title: PlayerProfile
player-profile.body: 钱包拥有的公开玩家身份状态。
player-profile.visible: Owner 钱包、位置、属性、装备摘要、已装备背包指针和更新 slot。
player-profile.trust: 玩家可以看到有哪些身份存在，以及每个公开档案指向哪个背包。

player-session.title: PlayerSession
player-session.body: 用于减少连续玩法操作钱包弹窗的短期 authority。
player-session.visible: Owner、session authority、允许动作标记、过期时间、最大动作数和已用动作数。
player-session.trust: 证明 session 权限是有边界的，而不是无限制隐藏操作钥匙。

chunk-broken.title: ChunkBrokenState
chunk-broken.body: 每个 Chunk 中玩家已经破坏方块的压缩记录。
chunk-broken.visible: 版本、容量、minY、数量，以及 packed broken-block 记录样本。
chunk-broken.trust: 在不把完整地形上链的情况下，让挖矿地形变化可审计。

resource-drop-table.title: ResourceDropTable
resource-drop-table.body: 挖矿奖励使用的有界 v2 资源掉落规则表。
resource-drop-table.visible: 来源方块、掉落方块、基础概率基点、海拔/深度范围、salt 和掉落体积范围。
resource-drop-table.trust: 玩家可以检查掉落规则，而不是信任黑箱奖励逻辑。

guardian-registry.title: GuardianRegistry
guardian-registry.body: 实时服务覆盖的全局注册表。
guardian-registry.visible: 国库 token、活跃数量、注册总数、质押金额、惩罚金额和区域大小。
guardian-registry.trust: 证明服务经济和覆盖规则是公开 PDA 数据。

guardian-region.title: GuardianRegion
guardian-region.body: 已注册实时区域端点和证明状态。
guardian-region.visible: 区域边界、拥有者、操作者、端点、TLS 标记、质押、惩罚和证明计数。
guardian-region.trust: 玩家可以验证谁在服务某个区域，以及是否持续提交存活证明。

backpack.title: Backpack
backpack.body: 玩家拥有的库存 PDA，用于方块资源、材料槽和物品引用。
backpack.visible: 拥有者、背包 ID、容量、物品数量、放置位置、更新 slot 和安全样本槽位。
backpack.trust: 库存可以从公开账户数据检查，而不是只能相信游戏 UI。

recipe-table.title: RecipeTable
recipe-table.body: Smelting 程序使用的 authority-owned 熔炼配方表。
recipe-table.visible: Authority、配方数量、更新 slot、热量等级、输入数量、输出数量和 recipe ID。
recipe-table.trust: 玩家在消耗背包资源前，可以检查哪些配方真实存在。

market-listing.title: MarketplaceListing
market-listing.body: 背包 slot 的公开市场挂单状态。
market-listing.visible: Seller、listing ID、币种、来源索引、完整来源 slot、价格、买家和最终状态。
market-listing.trust: 市场托管和结算可以被审计，不需要信任私有订单簿。

forged-items.title: 锻造物品记录
forged-items.body: 一个便利扫描，会从已上线的 Backpack 账户中找出锻造产物。
forged-items.visible: 来源账户类型、owner、backpack identity、锻造样本 slots、item code 和 item ID。
forged-items.trust: 通过真实账户数据展示锻造结果，同时诚实说明独立锻造 PDA 家族尚未上线。

civilization-rule-book.title: 文明 RuleBook
civilization-rule-book.visible: 作者、哈希、目标程序/PDA、阈值、风险等级、计票和状态。
civilization-rule-book.trust: 玩家可以在规则影响游戏前检查提案目标和权力阈值。

civilization-rule-signature.title: 文明签名
civilization-rule-signature.body: 一个玩家对规则的签署记录。
civilization-rule-signature.visible: 签署者、选择、快照哈希、快照权力和签署时间。
civilization-rule-signature.trust: 签名权力来自已结算文明值，而不是自报数字。

civilization-rule-tally.title: 文明计票
civilization-rule-tally.visible: 赞成、反对、弃权、挑战权力，所需权力和是否达标。
civilization-rule-tally.trust: 让玩家检查规则是否真的达到阈值。

civilization-execution-receipt.title: 文明执行回执
civilization-execution-receipt.body: 记录规则执行或确认的账户。
civilization-execution-receipt.visible: 规则书、执行者、执行 slot 和时间。
civilization-execution-receipt.trust: 把执行动作与通过的规则绑定。

civilization-power-snapshot.title: 文明值快照
civilization-power-snapshot.body: authority 签名的文明值窗口快照。
civilization-power-snapshot.visible: authority、快照哈希、总活跃权力、窗口和过期时间。
civilization-power-snapshot.trust: 玩家能检查本轮可用文明值总量和有效期。

civilization-citizen-power.title: 玩家文明值
civilization-citizen-power.body: 某个玩家在一个快照窗口里的文明值。
civilization-citizen-power.visible: 玩家、快照、权力、结算 slot 和过期时间。
civilization-citizen-power.trust: 证明单个签署者的权力来自已结算账户。

transparency.title: 玩家可以从合约代码一直审计到公开 PDA 状态。
transparency.body: NiceChunk 把公开状态作为游戏界面的一部分。玩家应该能检查谁存在、哪些背包和挂单存在、哪些配方启用、哪些区域服务实时玩法，以及哪些规则或账户仍只是计划。

cards.title: 玩家是公开账户记录，不是私有数据库里的隐藏行。
cards.body: PlayerProfile 和 PlayerSession PDA 会公开钱包、位置、已装备背包指针、session authority，以及客户端被允许使用的边界。

cards.title: 背包和市场挂单是可读取的存储对象。
cards.body: Backpack 和 MarketplaceListing 账户会显示物品数量、拥有者、状态、价格和安全样本 slot，方便玩家审计库存流转。
points: 锻造物品通过 Backpack item slot 显示。

cards.title: 地形和挖矿状态绑定到可验证的世界配置。
cards.body: GlobalConfig 固定世界种子和配置哈希，ChunkBrokenState 与 ResourceDropTable 公开哪些方块被挖过、以及哪些额外掉落规则存在。
points: 破坏方块记录压缩但可读。
掉落表是有边界的 PDA 数据。

cards.title: 治理必须先可检查，再拥有权力。
cards.body: 文明合约已经定义规则书、签名、计票、执行回执和文明值账户，但真实玩家提交仍必须等 devnet 证明。
points: 运行配置和门禁合约分开展示。
文明值需要 authority 结算。
规则目标必须指向可检查 PDA。

map.audit: 读取 PlayerProfile 账户，可查看钱包、位置、装备槽和已装备背包指针。
读取 Backpack 账户，可检查拥有者、容量、物品数量、方块资源和 item/material 槽位。
从 Backpack item slots 中读取锻造记录，不虚构一个尚未上线的独立锻造程序。
读取 RecipeTable 账户，可检查配方表、热量等级、输入数量、输出数量和更新 slot。
Read BuildSite, BuildingManifest, and BuildingShard accounts to inspect foundation footprints, upload progress, active revisions, and NCM3 payload metadata.
读取 GuardianRegion 和 GuardianRegistry 账户，可审计实时区域拥有者、端点、质押、证明次数和惩罚。
读取 MarketplaceListing，可检查卖家、买家、价格、币种、托管 slot、状态和结算 slot。

map.status: 合约已具备 / 仍门禁
map.audit: 读取 RuleBook、签名、计票、执行回执、文明值快照和玩家文明值账户，检查治理路径。

runtime.title: 游戏客户端现在实际配置使用什么。
runtime.body: 本区块读取公开 mainnet.json 运行索引，把已经进入游戏配置的程序和代码存在但仍门禁的合约分开。

config.label: 运行索引
config.title: 游戏仍使用公开运行配置。
config.body: mainnet.json 当前显示集群 {cluster}，应用版本 {version}。它保持为高频游戏配置，不是官网 i18n 大包。

programs.label: 活跃程序
programs.title: 当前客户端引用的程序。
programs.body: 这些 ID 是当前浏览器客户端从 mainnet.json 获取的权威程序 ID。

alias.label: 共享游戏程序
alias.title: 部分模块当前指向同一个 Program ID。
alias.body: 这就是当前真实游戏状态：chunk、backpack、smelting、market 仍接到共享 game program，直到拆分部署正式激活。

civilization.label: 文明系统
civilization.title: 文明合约已存在，但真实提交仍门禁。
civilization.bodyConfigured: 文明合约已经出现在运行配置中。
civilization.bodyGated: 文明合约已在这里文档化并可解码，但还没有进入当前 mainnet.json 运行配置。

logic.title: Understand the contracts as a connected trust graph.
logic.body: Each map shows the actor, program boundary, PDA evidence, and public verification surface. The goal is to explain what the contracts actually protect before a reader opens the code or RPC browser.

diagrams.title: Wallet intent becomes public state only through narrow program gates.
diagrams.body: The client can prepare instructions, but durable game state appears only after the wallet, session authority, and program checks agree on the same GlobalConfig and owner relationship.

nodes.label: Player wallet
nodes.detail: Owns profile creation, session refresh, backpack actions, and market settlement intent.

nodes.label: Session authority
nodes.detail: Short-lived key allowed to repeat selected gameplay actions without prompting the wallet every block.

nodes.label: Genesis Core
nodes.detail: Fixes the world seed, hashes, NCK mint, build bounds, and shared program assumptions.

nodes.label: Player Program
nodes.detail: Validates owner/profile/session relationships before gameplay instructions can rely on identity.

nodes.label: GlobalConfig
nodes.detail: The immutable runtime anchor read by the client and every dependent program.

nodes.label: PlayerProfile
nodes.detail: Public profile record with owner, position, equipment slots, backpack pointer, and forge progress.

nodes.label: PlayerSession
nodes.detail: Action budget and expiry record binding the wallet to a session authority.

nodes.label: Game client
nodes.detail: Reads mainnet.json, derives PDAs, and submits only the instructions the visible state allows.

nodes.label: PDA browser
nodes.detail: Reads program accounts from devnet RPC and decodes known account layouts in this page.

diagrams.title: Generated terrain, broken blocks, and rewards are separate audit surfaces.
diagrams.body: Chunk state does not store the whole world. It stores compact deltas against deterministic terrain plus bounded rule tables for resource and surface decoration behavior.

nodes.label: Mine block intent
nodes.detail: A wallet or session authority declares the world coordinate and expected generated block.

nodes.label: Foundation intent
nodes.detail: The player claims a bounded footprint that later protects occupied chunks from incompatible writes.

nodes.label: Chunk verifier
nodes.detail: Recomputes generated block identity from GlobalConfig before accepting a broken-block write.

nodes.label: Chunk authority PDA
nodes.detail: Lets related programs coordinate chunk occupancy without giving them unrestricted write access.

nodes.label: ChunkBrokenState
nodes.detail: Stores compact 3-byte records for blocks that differ from generated terrain.

nodes.label: FoundationChunk
nodes.detail: Indexes which player foundations occupy each chunk so building and mining can reason about conflicts.

nodes.label: ResourceDropTable
nodes.detail: Publishes extra-drop rules without embedding mutable probabilities in client-only code.

nodes.label: SurfaceDecorationTable
nodes.detail: Keeps surface decoration sync auditable against deterministic terrain faces.

diagrams.title: A player building is a staged, hashed payload before Guardians publish it.
diagrams.body: The Building program separates footprint ownership, upload progress, final manifest hash, chunk registration, and Guardian blueprint publication so each risk has a specific PDA witness.

nodes.label: Player session
nodes.detail: Build actions require the player profile and a valid session before site or manifest state changes.

nodes.label: NCM3 payload
nodes.detail: The client shards a building payload, commits the expected hash, and uploads bounded segments.

nodes.label: Building Program
nodes.detail: Owns BuildSite v2, upload shards, manifest finalization, resize state, and legacy migration.

nodes.label: Blueprint authority
nodes.detail: A restricted program-derived signer publishes verified blueprint summaries into Guardian regions.

nodes.label: BuildSite
nodes.detail: Stores owner, footprint, active/pending revisions, staged resize dimensions, and chunk counts.

nodes.label: BuildingManifest
nodes.detail: Stores expected hash, NCM dimensions, rotation, offsets, shard bitmap, and active/uploading status.

nodes.label: BuildingShard
nodes.detail: Stores one bounded piece of the upload so finalization can reconstruct and verify the payload hash.

nodes.label: Chunk occupancy index
nodes.detail: Building registration updates chunk occupancy through the chunk authority boundary.

nodes.label: GuardianRegion blueprint
nodes.detail: Guardian regions store blueprint hash, revision, and record count for realtime serving.

diagrams.title: Backpack slots move through smelting and market custody without becoming invisible.
diagrams.body: The inventory layer uses full slot snapshots and authority PDAs so manufacturing and market settlement can mutate backpack contents while preserving an inspectable trail.

nodes.label: Backpack owner
nodes.detail: Starts backpack creation, item use, smelting selection, listing, cancellation, or purchase delivery.

nodes.label: Buyer / seller
nodes.detail: Market settlement binds payment, seller, buyer, price, currency, and escrowed slot state.

nodes.label: Backpack Program
nodes.detail: Owns slot creation, removal, and authorized delivery from other programs.

nodes.label: Smelting Program
nodes.detail: Reads recipe tables, consumes selected resources/fuels, and appends material outputs.

nodes.label: Market Program
nodes.detail: Escrows a selected backpack slot and releases it on cancel or settlement.

nodes.label: Backpack
nodes.detail: Stores block resources, material slots, forged item refs, durability, grade, and item identity.

nodes.label: RecipeTable
nodes.detail: Stores heat, inputs, outputs, disabled flags, and per-output volume for recipes.

nodes.label: MarketplaceListing
nodes.detail: Stores seller, buyer, state, price, currency, and the full escrowed backpack slot.

nodes.label: Forged item view
nodes.detail: The PDA browser derives forged outputs from Backpack item slots instead of pretending a separate live forging program exists.

nodes.label: Treasury fee route
nodes.detail: Market settlement routes configured fees while preserving buyer delivery and seller proceeds in account state.

diagrams.title: Rule changes need signatures, tallies, receipts, and power snapshots before execution.
diagrams.body: Civilization is intentionally split into proposal evidence, signature evidence, tally evidence, execution receipts, and value snapshots so governance can be audited before it controls live game surfaces.

nodes.label: Rule author
nodes.detail: Publishes a rulebook with target program, target PDA, payload hash, and required power.

nodes.label: Citizen signer
nodes.detail: Signs yes/no against the exact rulebook and settled power snapshot.

nodes.label: Civilization Program
nodes.detail: Publishes rulebooks, signatures, tallies, receipts, power snapshots, and citizen power records.

nodes.label: Target adapter authority
nodes.detail: Binds approved rule execution to the target program instead of giving rule authors direct write access.

nodes.label: RuleBook
nodes.detail: Canonical proposal record with target, payload hash, expiry, and required power threshold.

nodes.label: RuleSignature
nodes.detail: One signer-side record that binds vote side and power to the exact rulebook.

nodes.label: RuleTally / Receipt
nodes.detail: Aggregates power and records whether a finalized rule was executed.

nodes.label: PowerSnapshot
nodes.detail: Authority-settled total active power used to validate impossible signature sets.

nodes.label: CitizenPower
nodes.detail: Per-citizen power record with expiry so old influence cannot silently remain valid.

evidence: Live runtime remains gated until configured
